functions.name: GetMemberProfile
functions.description: Return a privacy-minimized membership snapshot from authenticated YCC session attributes.

scope.description: Optional profile scope. Use summary for the default privacy-minimized membership view.

functions.name: DraftSupportReply
functions.description: Create an operator-reviewed support reply draft and, when authenticated member context is present, persist a support case and draft email.

subject.description: Short support subject such as renewal charge, damaged shipment, missing item, cancellation, or account question.

message.description: The member issue or operator notes to summarize into a support draft.

caseId.description: Optional caller-provided support case correlation ID.

functions.name: AddHumidorItem
functions.description: Add a cigar to the authenticated member's humidor inventory using provided cigar details.

name.description: Cigar display name when brand and line are not enough.

brand.description: Cigar brand, for example Padron or Davidoff.

line.description: Cigar line, for example 1964 Anniversary or Signature.

vitola.description: Vitola or shape, for example Toro, Robusto, Churchill, Panetela, or Perfecto.

functions.name: GetAdminQueueSummary
functions.description: Return safe admin support queue triage guidance for authorized admin or concierge operator sessions.

queue.description: Queue to summarize, such as support, billing, compliance, catalog, or humidor.

functions.name: DraftWeeklyNews
functions.description: Create an operator-review-only weekly cigar education/news draft with newsletter copy, source-note placeholders, and compliance review reminders for adult members of legal tobacco age.

topic.description: Topic or theme for the weekly cigar news draft.

timeframe.description: News window, for example this week or May 2026.

audience.description: Audience label. Defaults to adult YCC members of legal tobacco age.
